_instructions: Calculated via: shasum -a 256 <binary>. Update after each binary upgrade. For rustup, download the script first: curl -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs -o rustup-init.sh && shasum -a 256 rustup-init.sh. For brush, do NOT re-hash the archive you just downloaded — that only attests to what the server served. Upstream publishes its own digests per release: https://github.com/ArthurBrussee/brush/releases/download/<tag>/sha256.sum (and a <asset>.sha256 sidecar). darwin_brush is pinned to v0.3.0; it must be re-pinned whenever get_remote_version() starts resolving to a newer tag, otherwise the fail-closed check aborts the install.
